title: Constellation Andromeda (Roberts Space Industries, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Constellation Andromeda is a multi-crew gunship and freighter from RSI in Star Citizen for four to five people. It has a two-seat cockpit, turret seats and a small fighter docked at the back. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Constellation Andromeda: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Constellation Andromeda's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (four)
controls.text: The Constellation Andromeda has four guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (52 missiles)
controls.text: The Andromeda carries 52 missiles, a very large number. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.

controls.name: Cargo (96 SCU)
controls.text: The Andromeda holds 96 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Constellation Andromeda: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Constellation Andromeda besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Co-pilot seat
controls.text: A second seat in the Andromeda's cockpit. More people on board can share the work.
controls.context: A second person on board can take over jobs such as turrets, scanning or the radio, so the pilot can concentrate on flying.

controls.name: Turret stations (two)
controls.text: Two manned turrets for the crew. Each gunner sits in a turret of their own.
controls.context: A turret seat has its own controls: there the right stick aims the turret instead of steering the ship.

controls.name: Snub fighter (P-52 Merlin)
controls.text: A P-52 Merlin, a tiny fighter, is docked at the back of the ship.
controls.context: A crew member can launch in it to fight next to the big ship or scout ahead.
